citation: Landmeyer, J.E., and Belval, D.L., 1996, Water-chemistry and chloride fluctuations in the upper Floridan aquifer in the Port Royal Sound area, South Carolina, 1917-93: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 96-4102, map scale 1:200,000.
notes: Pages 1-52. Water-chemistry report. Map figures (pp. 10, 23, 31-34), figure 12 profiles (p. 38) and figure 14 (p. 43, garbled) were skipped. Water-chemistry tables (Table 2 starting p. 51, continued in the next packet) hold chemical analyses that do not fit the schema fields and were not recorded. Regional formation list on p. 16 (Cape Fear, Middendorf, Black Creek, Congaree, McBean, Barnwell) is cited from other reports and recorded only as names/ages stated. References: general chemistry/method references and Georgia-only references were skipped. Siple 1956-1969 entries are printed without author name (continuation entries); author inferred from the preceding entry.
